paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the progression of training and validation loss over epochs in a machine learning model. The x-axis is labeled "Epoch" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5 epochs. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", also using a linear scale, ranging from 0.5 to 2.25, with tick marks at increments of 0.25. The first line, representing training loss, is displayed in blue with a solid line and no markers. It starts with a high value of around 1.76 at epoch 0 and sharply declines till 1.0 loss by epoch 6 and steadily declines to approximately 0.5 by epoch 30. The second line, representing validation loss, is shown in green with a solid line and no markers. It starts around 1.74 at epoch 0, showing fluctuations with peaks and declines, reaching a high near 2.20 around epoch 11, before gradually decreasing with fluctuations to approximately 1.0 by epoch 30. A legend is given top right.
